root = Stack([title, panels, recommendation])
title = TextContent("Checkout Variant Comparison", "large-heavy")
panels = Stack([conversionPanel, orderPanel, bouncePanel], "row", "m", "stretch", "start", true)
conversionPanel = Card([conversionHeader, conversionChart])
conversionHeader = CardHeader("Conversion Rate", "Higher is better")
conversionChart = BarChart(variants, [conversionSeries], "grouped", "Variant", "Conversion (%)", 240)
conversionSeries = Series("Conversion", [3.1, 3.6, 3.3, 3.9])
orderPanel = Card([orderHeader, orderChart])
orderHeader = CardHeader("Average Order Value", "Higher is better")
orderChart = BarChart(variants, [orderSeries], "grouped", "Variant", "Order value ($)", 240)
orderSeries = Series("Average order", [54, 51, 56, 49])
bouncePanel = Card([bounceHeader, bounceChart])
bounceHeader = CardHeader("Bounce Rate", "Lower is better")
bounceChart = BarChart(variants, [bounceSeries], "grouped", "Variant", "Bounce (%)", 240)
bounceSeries = Series("Bounce", [41, 37, 40, 35])
recommendation = Callout("success", "Ship Variant D", "Express pay first leads conversion at 3.9% and has the lowest bounce rate at 35%. It gives up $5 in average order value versus control, but its estimated revenue per session is highest: $1.91 versus $1.67 for control, $1.84 for Variant B, and $1.85 for Variant C.")
variants = ["A", "B", "C", "D"]
